title: Zero Exchange Rate Bypass Allows Unconfigured Token Exploitation
description: If a token is added via addYieldStrategy() without corresponding setTokenConfig(), _normalizeAmount() returns raw amount treating 6-decimal as 18-decimal. This allows an attacker to drain yield for near-zero cost by exploiting the missing exchange rate configuration.
impact: Direct theft of all accumulated yield. An attacker can claim yield tokens at a massively discounted rate (treating 6-decimal tokens as 18-decimal), effectively stealing the entire yield balance.
attackPath: Identify a token added via addYieldStrategy() that lacks setTokenConfig() call
Call claim() for that token's yield
_normalizeAmount() returns raw amount without decimal adjustment
Attacker pays trivial amount (1e6 treated as 1e18) to receive full yield
Repeat until all yield is drained
recommendation: Add validation in addYieldStrategy() to require token configuration exists, or initialize default configuration. Alternatively, add a check in _normalizeAmount() to revert if exchangeRate is zero.
